meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (national unitary jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction applicable to SARL incorporation)

Convention between France and the United States of America for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and Capital (signed 24 July 1967, as amended by the 2006 and 2009 Protocols)

Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Articles 49-54 (freedom of establishment, directly applicable to EEA shareholders and cross-border incorporation)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.561-2-2, L.561-45 et seq. and R.561-31 et seq. (beneficial owner definition and French RBE register obligations); Code de commerce, Articles L.123-1, L.123-3, R.123-27 and R.123-166-1 to R.123-166-8 (RCS registration and UBO declaration procedure); Ordonnance n° 2016-1635 du 1er décembre 2016 (transposition of Directive (EU) 2015/849); Décret n° 2017-1160 du 12 juillet 2017; Arrêté du 2 juillet 2018 (UBO declaration format and electronic filing); Loi n° 2020-1721 du 29 décembre 2020 (centralization of the RBE in the INPI-operated Registre National des Entreprises through the Guichet unique); Directive (EU) 2018/843 as amended; public access restricted following CJEU judgments C-37/20 and C-601/20.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Statuts constitutifs (Articles of Association) in French
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French counsel (avocat) or notaire; notarial deed required only if share capital is contributed through real estate or where parties elect notarization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic deed - no apostille required; notarial direct execution where real property is contributed

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each shareholder and the first gérant (manager)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority in the shareholder's country of origin (embassy, consulate, notary or authorized public administration certifying the copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille under the 1961 Hague Convention or, for non-adherent states, consular legalization at a French embassy or consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or latest official extract from the home-country commercial register of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry or registered agent of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization by the French diplomatic post in the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank attestation of share capital deposit and blocking (attestation de dépôt et de consignation des fonds)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations receiving the SARL's initial capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic banking document - no legalization required; acceptable directly by the Greffe and RCS

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every shareholder, beneficial owner, proposed gérant and authorized representative against: (i) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) the OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions lists (mandatory because target payment rails include USD-denominated Swift LC and TT/Wire transfers); (iv) French national asset-freeze measures issued by the Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances; and (v) FATF and EU high-risk jurisdiction listings. PEP identification and enhanced due diligence apply per FATF Recommendation 12 and CMF Article L.561-10 whenever a PEP is identified as shareholder, manager, beneficial owner or authorized signatory. Adverse media search and source-of-funds verification must be documented and retained in the KYC file for at least five years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); RCS name verification records are held by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and are searchable through Infogreffe (infogreffe.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name (dénomination sociale) may be drawn from any language but must be expressed in Latin script for RCS indexing. If the desired name originates in a non-Latin or ideographic alphabet, the statutes must record a French transliteration, and that transliteration becomes the registered name. All official acts, commercial documents and the RCS file must reference the legal form suffix 'SARL'. French-language drafting is mandatory for the statutes submitted to the Guichet unique.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Europe (when used in a misleading institutional context)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not maintain a statutory name-reservation system for SARL dénomination sociale; the 30-day value reflects the validity period of a negative identity certificate (certificat de non-identité) issued by the CNGTC/Infogreffe. Where the Guichet unique rejects the filing due to name identity, homonymy or misleading confusion under Code de commerce Article R.123-27, the applicant shall: (1) resubmit amended statutes with a corrected name through the Guichet unique; (2) obtain a fresh non-identity certificate from the relevant Greffe; (3) where rejection is grounded on prior trademark rights, file observations or an invalidity action before the INPI within two months of the cited mark's publication; or (4) petition the judge responsible for RCS supervision (juge commis à la surveillance du registre) at the Tribunal de Commerce for an order to register the name. Any appeal must be filed within 15 days of the rejection notification.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for the wholesale distribution of Portland clinker (ISIC 4663). A licensed commercial domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) may be appointed under Code de commerce Article L.123-11-3 and R.123-167 to R.123-168. The domiciliation agreement must designate physical premises in France and the domiciliary must retain local document acceptance and record access. A pure mail-only virtual address without a managed local presence is not advisable and may be rejected for Kbis address verification by the Greffe.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - approximately 5-10% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 24 months for a non-licensed wholesale trader. Documentary verification by the Greffe occurs at incorporation; unannounced visits arise principally under tax audit powers (Code général des impôts Article L.16B) or when French authorities classify the entity as a letterbox during cross-border exchange-of-information procedures.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard SARL incorporation (EUR 1,300-2,200 fixed fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing international standard fee (EUR 100-150 per document)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Greffe registration taxes and fixed incorporation duties (frais de greffe and droits d'enregistrement)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and Direction générale des finances publiques

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Articles L. 210-1 et seq. (general company provisions), L. 223-1 to L. 223-43 (SARL), and L. 123-1 with R. 123-1 et seq. (registre du commerce et des sociétés), together with Decree No. 67-236 of 23 March 1967.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered-office arrondissement, operating through the INPI Guichet Unique portal (guichet-unique.entreprise.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution de société (electronic creation form M0) filed via the Guichet Unique, accompanied by the signed Statuts and supporting certificates.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital for a SARL; each share must have a par value of at least €1.00. Cash contributions must be paid up to at least 20% at subscription, with the balance payable within five years. Funds must be deposited in a regulated French bank or with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and remain blocked until issuance of the K-bis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned, acting as founding associate and sole quotaholder of the SARL, HEREBY RESOLVES as follows. FIRST: the share capital of €[●], divided into [●] Shares of €1.00 each, is subscribed in full by the associate and shall be governed by the annexed Articles of Association. SECOND: the registered office is fixed at [address], France, and any relocation within the same department may be decided by the gérant. THIRD: [Name] is appointed Gérant for an indefinite term, with powers to open bank mandates, incur obligations, and represent the company before all authorities. FOURTH: all incorporation filings, publication formalities, and opening of the corporate bank account are hereby authorized and ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Review and Execution of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French legal counsel or notary (notaire) acting with the founding associate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the French-language Statuts d'une SARL compliant with Articles L. 223-1 to L. 223-43, including corporate name, registered office, corporate object covering wholesale distribution of Portland clinker and hydraulic cement, duration (99 years), share capital, par value, share allocation, appointment and powers of the gérant, and voting rules. Execute the Statuts by each associate's signature or by powers of attorney; if real property is contributed, execute by authentic deed before a notary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries the drafting, amend the Statuts by private supplementary agreement, re-execute, and resubmit with a cover letter; no curing penalty applies at draft stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocking of Cash Capital and Issuance of Deposit Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Regulated French commercial bank or notary's escrow account (Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of the company 'en formation'. Deposit at least 20% (or 100% if the articles so provide) of the cash contributions. Obtain the formal attestation from the bank or notary certifying that the funds are blocked and may be released only against presentation of the K-bis extract.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of the depositing associate(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account on KYC grounds, cure by submitting the business plan and beneficial-ownership declarations; if irremediable, request restitution under the deposit rules and re-deposit with another regulated institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Statutory Legal Notice in a Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: JAL authorized in the département of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Place the mandatory notice containing the corporate name, legal form, capital, registered office, object, duration, gérant identity, and intended place of RCS registration. Verify strict conformity with the Statuts. Obtain the publisher's justificatif de parution dated and stamped.
required_dossiers: Copy of the gérant's appointment deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL notice contains typographical errors, cause the publisher to issue a corrected notice and obtain a revised justificatif within eight days for inclusion in the registry filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing of the Incorporation Dossier with the Guichet Unique (INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) via guichet-unique.entreprise.fr
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the fully dematerialized dossier: M0 creation declaration, signed Statuts, capital deposit certificate, JAL publication proof, beneficial-owner declaration, gérant's sworn statement of no disqualification, proof of lawful occupation of the registered office, and associate KYC data. Pay the INPI and registry duties online and await transmission to the commercial court registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Guichet Unique issues an observation or rejection, correct the identified deficiencies within the imposed period (generally 15 days) and resubmit; a complete and regular dossier must be registered within ten working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration at the RCS and Issuance of the K-bis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered-office arrondissement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon transmission by the Guichet Unique, the Registry allocates the RCS number, registers the company under the SIREN/SIRET identifiers, and issues the official extract K-bis. Use the K-bis to release blocked capital and open the definitive corporate bank account.
required_dossiers: Approved incorporation dossier transmitted by the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the K-bis extract contains errors in identity, corporate object, or capital, file a demande de rectification with the greffe at no additional fee; if refused, apply to the President of the Commercial Court by référé.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) / Inspection des Installations Classées (IIC) under the Préfet du département
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Récépissé de déclaration or arrêté d'enregistrement d'Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE), Rubrique 2520 (dépôts de ciment) and/or Rubrique 2517 (transit de produits minéraux), Code de l'environnement

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL territoriale – Inspection des Installations Classées, French Ministry for Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE 'Enregistrement' for cement/clinker storage capacity of 1,000 tonnes or more; simplified 'Déclaration' for capacity between 100 and 1,000 tonnes; a full environmental impact assessment (étude d'impact) is required only where the Autorisation thresholds are reached or in environmentally sensitive zones, subject to DREAL screening under Article R. 122-2.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the general prescriptions of the ministerial Order of 6 February 1998: dust emissions in dedusted flows ≤ 30 mg/Nm³; fugitive PM10 controlled by silo filters, covered conveyors, water spraying, and wheel-wash systems; no untreated process wastewater discharge; stormwater from loading areas collected and treated with maximum total suspended solids of 100 mg/L; waste handling under Chapter XIX of the ICPE order.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Permis de construire validated by an approved technical control bureau verifying structural load integrity of silos and conveyor gantries; CONSUEL electrical-installation conformity certificate; fire-safety scheme reviewed by the Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours (SDIS), including fire access roads, hydrants, and extinguishing equipment; workplace health and safety clearance issued by the Inspection du travail covering dust exposure, silicosis prevention, and safe loading/unloading operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities obtain statutory TIN/VAT ID by registering on impots.gouv.fr or via a French tax representative; French SARL entities use SIREN/SIRET obtained from INSEE for identification and TVA number (FR followed by SIREN).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box; available regimes include micro-entreprise for small businesses, export zero-rating, and specific hybrid mismatch elections under the Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD)

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €85,000 annual taxable turnover in France triggering mandatory registration for domestic suppliers; non-residents register if supplies exceed threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (facturation électronique) for B2B transactions above certain thresholds; API submission to tax authorities for digital stamping and clearance compliance

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for goods exported outside the EU or intra-EU supplies with proof of delivery to non-EU; requires customs export declaration and proof of non-EU destination
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims result in 80% penalty on uncollected VAT plus interest; retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT if export not substantiated; potential criminal prosecution for intentional misrepresentation

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (national central bank, Eurosystem/ESCB member) is the monetary authority; exchange-control and capital-account policy rests with the Direction Générale du Trésor (DG Trésor) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance; ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) supervises banks and payment institutions; TRACFIN is the financial intelligence unit; DGDDI (national customs) enforces trade-settlement and repatriation rules under Article 358 of the national Customs Code (Code des douanes).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible; France abolished exchange controls in 1990 and applies the EU Treaty free movement of capital (TFEU arts. 63-66) and the OECD Codes of Liberalisation. Current and capital accounts are equally open: no prior exchange authorization exists for any payment, including dividends, shareholder loan repayments, or liquidation proceeds to non-residents. Practical hurdles are administrative rather than restrictive: (i) payments to/from non-EU jurisdictions exceeding EUR 12,500 must be routed through an intermediary credit institution established in France; (ii) foreign trade operations exceeding EUR 12,500 must be 'domiciliated' with the bank, which records the Banque de France balance-of-payments 'motif' code; (iii) profit remittance requires distributable reserves and the standard corporate formalities, but no FX or central bank approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or mandatory conversion of export proceeds into EUR has existed since total liberalisation in 1990. However, for non-EU trade, Article 358 of the national Customs Code still requires exporters to justify, within 150 days from the customs export date, the repatriation of the full export proceeds to a French authorised intermediary bank, and importers to justify full payment of imports within 30 days from the customs import date; breaches carry customs penalties (amende) of up to EUR 10,000 per operation. Proceeds may be held in foreign-currency accounts or reused for authorised overseas payments, provided the bank records them on the 'fiche de domiciliation' and reports the flows to the Banque de France.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (compte bloqué) and Operational Account (compte courant professionnel, incl. USD/CNY current accounts)
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account with dedicated commodity trade-finance desk
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account; Crédit Agricole CIB for structured LC and pre-export facilities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and corporate formalities filing (dépôt des comptes annuels au greffe du tribunal de commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Infogreffe for the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual accounts must be approved by the shareholders' meeting within six months of each fiscal year-end; the approved accounts are filed with the Registrar within one month after approval. For a 31 December fiscal year, filing is ordinarily due by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or failure to file exposes the SARL to an administrative fine of up to €1,500; the public prosecutor or any interested party may apply for court-ordered deregistration; non-filing for two consecutive years may trigger ex officio radiation (strike-off) from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale – forms 2065 and 2052 supporting schedule)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques – Service des impôts des entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year ending 31 December, the return is due by the second working day after 1 May; for any other fiscal year-end, the return is due within three months after that fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 10% late-filing penalty with a €150 minimum, plus late-payment interest of 0.20% per month; after a 30-day formal demand the penalty increases to 40%, and to 80% for deliberate concealment, with possible tax reassessment and criminal liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local business property contribution declaration (CFE – formulaire n°1447-C-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques – Service des impôts des entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The annual CFE activity declaration must be returned by the second working day after 1 May of the assessment year; the CFE itself is generally payable in December of the assessment year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted declaration gives rise to a late-filing increase of 5% to 10%, plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.20%; an understated business base may be reassessed, and intentional concealment may carry penalties of up to 80%.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial-owner annual status and update filing (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs au RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Infogreffe
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: France does not impose a separate calendar annual UBO filing where ownership is unchanged; however, the UBO declaration must always be current and must be updated within 15 days after any change in beneficial ownership. An update is coordinated with the annual accounts filing and statutory-status declaration.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update or submission of false beneficial-owner information is a criminal offence punishable for individuals by imprisonment of up to six months and a fine of up to €7,500; for legal persons the applicable fine is up to €37,500, and the Registrar may reject the underlying filing until the declaration is corrected.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory for a French SARL when, at the balance-sheet date, it exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds: balance-sheet total above €6,000,000; net turnover above €12,000,000; annual average permanent employees above 50. If the thresholds are not crossed, no mandatory audit is required, although shareholders may still appoint an auditor by ordinary resolution or by court order.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual annual accounts of a French SARL must be prepared under French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général per ANC Regulation No. 2014-03 and the Code de commerce). IFRS as adopted in the EU is permitted for consolidated accounts of listed groups; an unlisted French SARL prepares its statutory accounts under French GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a separate annual UBO declaration for an unchanged ownership structure; the SARL must maintain an accurate RCS beneficial-owner declaration and update it within 15 days after any change. At the annual accounts-filing cycle, the legal representative must confirm that the previously registered UBO information remains unchanged or file the updated declaration before the annual filing is accepted. Statutory registers must be kept at the registered office or at an accessible location and produced for inspection during official audits.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders and Share-Transfer Movements (Registre des associés et des mouvements de titres)
Register of Shareholders' Meetings and Managerial Decisions / Minute Book (Registre des procès-verbaux des décisions des associés)
Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Sector-specific reduced rates (e.g. 15% for R&D intensive companies); no general tax holidays

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 1201 - Déclaration de résultat (liasse fiscale) via impots.gouv.fr electronic filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 15th day of the 4th month following fiscal year-end (e.g. 15 April for calendar year)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report only French-sourced income; exclude foreign income
Adjust for related-party transactions per transfer pricing rules
Apply deductions and treaty relief where applicable

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 0.5% of tax due per month of delay (maximum 5% or €75,000); criminal sanctions including imprisonment for evasion

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain Tax Residency Certificate (TRC); submit application for reduced rate via impots.gouv.fr or bilateral DTA
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 10% statutory rate, reduced to 0-10% under most treaties; Interest: 0% statutory rate, reduced to 0% under OECD treaties

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a company without genuine economic activity or substance
